consequence.statement: The rejected-update metric is now published as `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected`.
consequence.remediation: Change any monitoring queries, dashboards or alerts that use the old metric name to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected` was renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.

decision.reason: The upgrade notes state that this metric was renamed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected` to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected` [ev-f7021b9d3606]. The section explains that the prefix of all Envoy NPDS metrics changed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_` [ev-77f05428497a]. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. The metric is still published under a new name, so behavior-change (review) with low severity fits, and the remediation to update queries is reasonable. Picking a failure kind here would over-claim mandatory work.
